cmsSettings.directorMessage: Founded in Dhubri with a clear mission to bridge quality academic mentoring and practical digital skills across Western and Lower Assam, Success Point Educational Institute operates on transparency, personal attention, and verifiable student outcomes. Every learner—whether preparing for board exams, computer literacy, competitive recruitment, or seeking honest guidance on recognized distance pathways—deserves ethical counsel and structured support.
cmsSettings.legalDisclaimer: Success Point Educational Institute is an independent academic coaching, computer training, vocational skill institute, and educational consultancy headquartered in Dhubri, Assam. We do not independently confer university degrees or falsely claim UGC/AICTE university status. Academic counseling and facilitation for recognized board or university programs are conducted strictly within authorized institutional boundaries.

blogs.title: Choosing Between Computer Diploma (DCA/PGDCA) and Tally GST After Class 12 in Assam
blogs.summary: A practical guide for students in Dhubri, Kokrajhar, and Goalpara evaluating office IT skills versus accounting specialization.
blogs.content: Students completing Class 12 often wonder whether to pursue a broad computer diploma or specialized GST accounting. For Assam state government Grade III roles requiring computer proficiency, a 6-month DCA or 12-month PGDCA provides essential MS Office, database, and typing skills. Those targeting private-sector accounts and MSME billing benefit immediately from Tally Prime with GST.
blogs.author: Academic Advisory Desk, Dhubri

blogs.title: 2026–27 Assam & National Scholarship Checklist for School and College Learners
blogs.summary: Essential documents—income certificate, bonafide verification, Aadhaar-bank seeding—required before applying on NSP.
blogs.content: Keep your previous academic marksheet, active bank passbook seeded with Aadhaar, valid income certificate from the circle office, and institutional bonafide letter ready prior to portal deadlines.
